message:
Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Customer contracts",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Contracts",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Customer (text; required)",
     "Value a year (money; required)",
     "Start (date)",
     "Renews on (date)",
     "Notice (days)",
     "Notice date (computed; worked out: Renews on + 0 days)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Budget owner (person)",
     "Billing email (email)",
     "Customer contact (text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Draft (start)",
     "Legal review",
     "Signed",
     "Active",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Ended (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Contract managers: every row",
   "Contract owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": []
 },
 {
  "name": "Hiring",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Candidates",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Candidate (text; required)",
     "Email (email)",
     "Position (text)",
     "Opening (link; links to Openings)",
     "Hiring manager (person)",
     "Stage (step)",
     "Applied On (date)",
     "Source (text)",
     "Referred by (person)",
     "Offer Amount (money)",
     "Offer approval (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Start Date (date)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Applied (start)",
     "Phone screen",
     "Interview",
     "Offer",
     "Hired (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Openings",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Role (text; required)",
     "Team (choice; required; choices: Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance)",
     "Hiring manager (person; required)",
     "Salary band (money_range; required)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Open (start)",
     "Filled (last)",
     "Closed (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Interviews",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Interview (text; required)",
     "Candidate (link; required; links to Candidates)",
     "Interviewer (person; required)",
     "Date (date; required)",
     "Scorecard (choice; choices: 1, 2, 3, 4)",
     "Notes (long_text)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Hiring admins: every row",
   "Hiring managers: their own rows",
   "Interviewers: their own rows",
   "Everyone: open roles: every row",
   "Everyone: referrals: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a candidate enters Offer and the Offer Amount is above the top of the opening's salary band, ask Wade to approve or decline it in Offer approval before the offer is sent.",
   "On the date of each interview, ask the interviewer for a scorecard from 1 to 4.",
   "When a candidate enters Hired, move their opening to Filled.",
   "When a candidate in Hiring enters Hired, start a first-week plan in Onboarding with their name, their start date, the candidate linked, and their hiring manager as the plan's manager."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Tools and budgets",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Tools",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Vendor (text; required)",
     "Category (text)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Seats (number)",
     "Annual cost (money)",
     "Renewal date (date)",
     "Renewal approval (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Active (start)",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Cancelled (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Budgets",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Budget (text; required)",
     "Team (choice; required; choices: Engineering, Growth, Operations, Finance, Leadership)",
     "Quarter (text; required)",
     "Quarter starts (date)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Spent (computed; worked out: the total of Payable in Expenses at Approved or Paid)",
     "Left (computed; worked out: Amount − Spent)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Tool and budget admins: every row",
   "Tool keepers: every row",
   "Tool owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "30 days before a tool's renewal date, move it to Renewal due and email its owner to remind them it renews soon.",
   "When a tool enters Renewal due and costs more than $5,000 a year, ask Wade to approve or decline the renewal in Renewal approval."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Onboarding",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Plans",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "New starter (text; required)",
     "Candidate (link; links to Hiring › Candidates)",
     "Start date (date)",
     "Manager (person)",
     "Buddy (person)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Planned (start)",
     "First week",
     "Complete (last)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Tasks",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Task (text; required)",
     "Plan (link; required; links to Plans)",
     "For (choice; choices: IT, Manager, Buddy)",
     "Assigned to (person)",
     "Details (long_text)",
     "Due (date)",
     "Progress (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "To do (start)",
     "Done (last)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Onboarding admins: every row",
   "Task owners: their own rows",
   "Plan managers: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a plan starts, ask Aisha to pick a buddy for the new starter, in the Buddy column.",
   "When a plan starts, create an IT task for Jon (laptop, accounts and software seats) and a task for the plan's manager, each linked to the plan.",
   "When a plan's Buddy is filled, create a task for the buddy, linked to the plan.",
   "When a plan enters First week, add a row to Tools in Tools and budgets for the new starter's software seats, named after the starter, with category Starter seats, Jon as owner and 1 seat."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Spend",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Expenses",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Expense ID (text; required)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Employee (person; required)",
     "Merchant (text)",
     "Description (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Diners (number)",
     "Payable (computed; worked out: 40 × 1 if Diners is empty, otherwise Diners if Category is Meals and Amount over 40 × 1 if Diners is empty, otherwise Diners, otherwise Amount)",
     "Receipt (file)",
     "Budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Budgets)",
     "Project Code (text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Paid (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Purchases",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Purchase (text; required)",
     "Supplier (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Requested by (person; required)",
     "Needed by (date)",
     "Approval (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Ordered",
     "Received (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Renewal requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Renewal (text; required)",
     "Customer (text)",
     "Yearly value (money)",
     "Renews on (date)",
     "Budget owner (person)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Budgeted (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Spend admin: every row",
   "Spend finance: every row",
   "Everyone: own spend: their own rows",
   "Purchase approvers: every row",
   "Renewal budget owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When an expense is submitted without a receipt, ask the person it is for to attach one in Receipt, and keep it waiting on them until it is attached.",
   "When an expense in Submitted has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena to approve or reject it.",
   "When an expense in Submitted has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena to approve or reject it.",
   "When an expense enters Approved, email Lena that it is ready to be marked paid with the next payroll.",
   "When a purchase over $2,000 is requested, ask Krishna to approve or decline it in Approval before it is ordered.",
   "When a purchase of $2,000 or less is requested, ask Lena to approve or decline it in Approval.",
   "When a purchase's Approval is set to Approved, move it to Approved.",
   "When a purchase's Approval is set to Declined, move it to Declined.",
   "When a renewal request starts, ask its budget owner to approve or decline it in Decision.",
   "When a renewal request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Budgeted; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined.",
   "When a renewal request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Budgeted; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Time off",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Leave requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Employee (person; required)",
     "Leave type (choice; required; choices: Vacation, Sick, Personal)",
     "From (date; required)",
     "To (date; required)",
     "Days (days; required)",
     "Days left (computed; worked out: the Employee's leave entries added up)",
     "Note (text)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Draft (start)",
     "Requested",
     "Approved",
     "Taken (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Leave entries",
    "kind": "ledger",
    "columns": [
     "Employee (person; required)",
     "Days (days; required)",
     "Reason (choice; required; choices: Yearly allowance, Vacation taken, Correction)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Request (link; links to Leave requests)",
     "Note (text)",
     "Balance after (days)",
     "Reverses (link; links to Leave entries)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Time off admins: every row",
   "Balance keepers: every row",
   "Employees: own requests: their own rows",
   "Managers: team requests: their team's rows",
   "Employees: own balance: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a request enters Requested, ask the employee's manager to approve or decline it in Decision.",
   "When a request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Approved and email the employee; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined and email the employee.",
   "When a request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Approved and email the employee; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined and email the employee.",
   "The day after a request's last day (To), if it is still in Approved, move it to Taken.",
   "When a request enters Taken and its leave type is Vacation, add an entry to Leave entries for the employee with the days taken as a negative number, the reason Vacation taken and the request linked."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. 60 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner to ask them to act on the renewal.
2. 30 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still in Renewal due, email Wade and the owner to tell them nobody has acted.
3. When a contract enters Renewal due, start a request in Renewal requests in Spend, named after the customer, with the customer, the yearly value, the renewal date and the contract's budget owner.
